formal: A startup has offered me a product role at a salary approximately twenty percent higher than my current earnings. They have requested my answer by Friday. My plan is to accept the offer by telephone on Friday and to submit my resignation at my current employer that same afternoon, before the written contract has arrived. I have weighed the raise against both the product role and the risk associated with a startup, and I have made my decision. I rarely bring employment decisions to you, and consulting you about a career move is unusual for me. What is your view?
